sections.Profile:
"Playtime," released by Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co. in October 1968, is a two-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Al Schlappa, Jerry Koci, and John Gore. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and four kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Women, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Original Theme
